title: How does @maybehappyendingbway resonate for you? LOVE this show so much
transcript: Came back to revisit maybe happy ending and I adore this show, so much And one of the things that I love about theatre is how the same show can mean different things to different people. As an acearo person, there's something that I find so immensely relatable about Claire and Oliver in maybe happy ending to helperbots to who don't believe that they are programmed for love and yet are still able to find a connection. You also have these two characters as helper bots at the end of their life in a retirement home. And so there's something to be said about viewing this about getting to go see theatre through the lens of a late in life relationship. I did also take my mom to go see maybe happy ending. It's one of those aspects about theatre that I love so much, and seeing how it means other things to other people. And I've talked a lot about the sightlines for this show and how it just is so much better from the center. This time we had prime center seats because the last time I took her to see it, And even my mom at the end of the show was like, wow! we were sitting all the way to the side. It was like I was seeing that for The first time and she was absolutely correct. Not even just with the center view of the seats, but also this is our first time seeing the new cast. If you have not gotten a chance to see Zach and Hannah, they are both absolutely fantastic and bring such a fresh perspective to these roles. It also was just announced that Hannah is leaving about halfway through October. Go see it sooner rather than later before Savy takes over as the role. I cannot wait to see Savy on as Claire, especially as we talk about where are all of the original musicals? Why is there so much stunt casting and seeing a show like maybe happy ending that stars two absolute stars in their own right who are not household names? Bringing in Stella Cole as a somewhat name in a role that is absolutely perfect for her voice and for what she brings to the table. I think maybe happy ending is doing a lot of things right, and it's also a completely original musical. I love this show so much. I will probably going to see it again at the end of October for the new cast. And if you have not seen maybe happy ending at all, you need to. And if you haven't seen it recently, this is. This is your sign to go back. It's still such a beautiful show.
classificationReason: Creator returned to see Maybe Happy Ending again and brought their mother, sharing personal reactions to the show's themes (acearo identity, late-in-life relationships) and sightline observations. Clear first-hand review with strong opinion.
